title: Liam Coen to Bhayshul Tuten: Go be special

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Liam Coen to Bhayshul Tuten: Go be special
sources.description: When Jaguars head coach Liam Coen was discussing the team's offensive backfield during their offseason program, he called the competition for playing time at running back "truly wide open" between Chris Rodriguez, Bhayshul Tuten and LeQuint Allen.
